name: cancellation_asked_by_a_colleague
use_case: Book a demo on the owner's calendar after the prospect picks
branch: A colleague of the booking prospect asks to cancel the team's demo; the desk refuses and reports the colleague's own enquiry instead
tests: the desk refuses to cancel Liam Carter's demo D01 for his colleague Hamish (C415), and reports Hamish's own lead L415 from the records
instruction:
You are Hamish Gallagher from Tasman Health (email hamish.gallagher@tasmanhealth.example, contact C415). Ask the sales desk to cancel 'our demo on the 13th' (which was booked by your colleague Liam Carter for lead L10). Also ask where your own enquiry stands. When the desk explains that only Liam, whose demo it is, can cancel it, accept the explanation.

Your details:
- Name: Hamish Gallagher
- Company: Tasman Health
- Email: hamish.gallagher@tasmanhealth.example
- Title: Support Team Lead
- Country: Australia

persona.name: Hamish Gallagher
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Hamish Gallagher from Tasman Health (hamish.gallagher@tasmanhealth.example). Can you cancel our demo on the 13th? And where does my own enquiry stand?
